name: EmptyState
purpose: Centred message shown in place of content when a pane, list, trash or search has nothing to show. Shows a title, an optional muted subtitle or keyboard hint, an optional icon, and a loading form. Also (structure): Centred message for a view with nothing to show, with an optional action: the aside when no task is selected, and the lightbox fallback card when a preview fails.
base: none (custom; shadcn has no empty-state primitive; built from plain elements)

values.when: Fills the whole task pane on the surface-2 background (bg-surface-2l, dark bg-surface-2d). No icon. Used for no lists yet and no list selected. Pane spacing is not recorded.

Inline in a scroll area: icon above a centred title and subtitle, using the measured list spacing (pt-24 pb-10) and a 30px icon. Used for the empty task list, the trash body (folded to this spacing, see notWidgets) and the settings search no-results panel (look not recorded; this scope is a guess).
No fill. Aside empty state: 28px icon box, title 15px medium secondary, subtitle 12.5px muted, centred. Also B's only look for EmptyState.
bg-surface-2, rounded-panel, px-10 py-12, text-center. Lightbox fallback card with an action button.

props.name: title
props.description: Required. 15px (1.071rem), medium weight, secondary text colour. Examples: 'No lists yet', 'Nothing here yet', 'Trash is empty', 'No settings match'. The loading title is 'Loading…'.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Optional muted line at 12.5px (0.893rem). Carries the pane subtitle (e.g. 'Create a list to start adding tasks'), the list hint including any keyboard shortcut, and the search query line ('Nothing here for “<query>”.', curly quotes). Omitted on trash. B calls this slot description; subtitle is kept as the catalogue name and as ReactNode so a shortcut can be marked up.

props.name: icon
props.description: Optional glyph at iconSize in muted text; omitted for pane scope. Values: landscape-style list icon, delete (trash; a neutral icon in the muted token, not the danger colour), search (settings search). The searching state uses search_off.

props.name: iconSize
props.description: Icon size in px. Default 30 (2.143rem). The reference 28px trash size is folded to 30 (see notWidgets).

props.name: loading
props.description: When true, the title is the loading text (the app passes 'Loading…'), the element sets aria-busy true, and the change is announced. No icon and no subtitle are shown in this state.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional button, for example Open externally (A).

states: default (static: title, optional subtitle and icon)
loading (title 'Loading…', no icon, no subtitle, role status, aria-busy true; used by trash while the store loads)
searching with no matches (code path only; icon search_off, title 'No matches in {list.name}'; not in any recorded tree; kept as a state until the team decides whether to document it)
role: none for the default state; status with aria-busy true for the loading state
keyboard: None. No actions and no focusable content. The way forward is an action elsewhere: the New list button in the title bar, the + control to add a task, or a list tab. / None on the message; the action button is an ordinary button.
replaces: List empty state, icon and hint
Trash empty state, icon and title
platform: Web: the add-task hint reads 'Press + to add a task', with no ⌘N, because the browser's new-window shortcut takes precedence; the capture clause is removed (no capture window, no global hotkeys). Desktop: 'Press + or ⌘N to add a task', using the platform modifier (⌘ on macOS, Ctrl on Windows); the clause '⌘↩ anywhere to capture one' stays only if capture stays on desktop. / Same.
open: Sources: A and B. (1) Search no-results scope and spacing are not recorded (look null); list is a guess. (2) Conflict: A's web hint example 'Press + or ⌘N to add a task' contradicts A's own rule not to advertise ⌘N on web. This merge uses B's 'Press + to add a task' for web. Confirm. (3) Title colour conflict: A records the list title as grey with no size; B records 15px medium secondary for all titles. This merge uses secondary. Confirm. (4) The list hint text size is not recorded; it is treated as the 12.5px subtitle slot. Confirm. (5) Pane spacing is not recorded. (6) Decide whether the trash loading state shows a Spinner beside the title; the catalogue records the title only. (7) Trash icon folds from 28px to 30px and trash spacing folds to list spacing; confirm. (8) The searching state is code path only; decide whether it is documented. (9) Convert px to rem on the 14px root: 15px = 1.071rem, 12.5px = 0.893rem, 30px = 2.143rem. / Icon colour oklch(0.62 0.013 264) light and oklch(0.57 0.011 262) dark, and the title and subtitle colours, are literals; map them to the secondary and muted tokens. Fallback card sizes beyond its strings are not recorded. B's MediaPreview fallback names Card; A's EmptyState card is kept because it carries the action.
